reports.title: Unaudited condensed consolidated interim statement of comprehensive loss

desk.headline: Loss narrows to $0.18 a share, better than estimates; FDA meeting on GH001 depression programme planned for Q1 2027; no financial guidance
results: The quarterly loss narrowed to $12.5m ($0.18 a share) from $14.0m ($0.23), as both research and admin costs dipped.
Cash and securities stood at $350.6m, helped by the $111.2m share sale in April; nothing has been sold yet under a $200m at-the-market programme.
A healthy-volunteer study backs one fixed dose of GH001 per visit using the company's own inhaler device.
The FDA gave positive early feedback on the pivotal trial design for treatment-resistant depression.
GH Research appointed Vanina Popova, formerly of Johnson & Johnson, as Chief Development Officer.

guidance.summary: GH Research has no revenue and gives no financial guidance. It plans an End-of-Phase 2 FDA meeting in Q1 2027, with the depression pivotal programme to start soon after, and aims to start a postpartum depression pivotal programme in the second half of 2027.

watch: The End-of-Phase 2 FDA meeting on GH001 in Q1 2027 and the start of pivotal trials.
Plans for a postpartum depression pivotal programme in the second half of 2027.
Use of the $200m at-the-market share programme and cash burn.
